name: Cadeler A/S
summary: Cadeler A/S operates as an offshore wind farm transportation and installation contractor in Denmark. The company also provides wind farm maintenance, construction, decommissioning, and other tasks within the offshore industry. It operates two offshore jack up windfarm installation vessels under the Wind Orca and Wind Osprey The company was formerly known as Swire Blue Ocean A/S and changed its name to Cadeler A/S in October 2020. Cadeler A/S was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark. Cadeler A/S operates as a subsidiary of Swire Pacific Offshore Operations (Pte) Ltd.
